sql:
SELECT cls, count(*) trips, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt, sum(yt)*1.0/sum(anglers) ypa
FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 130 AND 152
GROUP BY cls ORDER BY ypa DESC

SELECT cls, boat, count(*) trips, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt, sum(yt)*1.0/sum(anglers) ypa
FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season=1 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 250 AND 315 AND cls IN ('day_1_5','overnight','three_quarter')
GROUP BY cls, boat HAVING count(*)>=3 ORDER BY ypa DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT index_id, value, avail_doy FROM climate WHERE avail_season=2 ORDER BY avail_doy DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, boat, anglers, yt FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 130 AND 152 AND yt>0 ORDER BY fish_date_doy

SELECT cls, count(*) trips, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt, sum(yt)*1.0/sum(anglers) ypa
FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season=1 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 250 AND 315 AND cls IN ('hd_am','hd_pm','hd_twilight')
GROUP BY cls ORDER BY ypa DESC
